description: Everything the claim skill (skill.md) does and nothing else. Machine-readable; checked against state.json and the verifier's own rules by scripts/verifier.py and tests/test_permissions.py.

allow.purpose: read the live price, payee and next block
read-only Base mainnet JSON-RPC: check the payment's confirmations and the USDC Transfer log
allow.endpoint: any public Base mainnet JSON-RPC endpoint chosen by the agent

allow.purpose: pay the claim price through an x402 client (USDC authorization from the agent's own wallet)

secrets.note: The skill never reads a key, a credential or a secret file. The agent signs with its own wallet; no private key is ever sent anywhere or committed.

spend.note: The cap is the genesis-tier price (state.json current_floor_usdc); a later tier raises it, never silently.

pull_request.scope: only the three claim files of one payment
